How admin access works. Administrator rights come from a secure Firebase custom claim set on the server (see tools/setAdminClaim.js) — never from this screen, and changing a student's role here does not grant admin. Disabling or deleting a signed-in user's Firebase Auth record requires the Admin SDK, so this console manages the Firestore profile only. Suspension signs a student straight out on their next load.
